RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.arom: [sine][blue]If the sky ahead were no longer just a small patch, would people stop chasing the sun and the moon?[/blue][/sine]
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.card: Ray's cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.defe: Further excavation can wait... hold the medical work for now. I'll go deal with the threat.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.desc:
A well-digger from Rim Billiton, a hunter of few words.
She seeks light in the depths of the mines, and a new purpose aboard Rhodes Island.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.even: I don't want to... stay in the dark.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.flav: She was pulled up out of the mine, she has come a long way, and she is still searching.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.gold: This gold is enough to start testing.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.sele: I passed the Operator test, Doctor. Thank you for the invitation. That journey of searching is over, but I want to find a new purpose aboard this ship.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.unlo: Complete a run as [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
RAY_MOD_CHARACTER_RAY_MOD_CHARACTER.vict: ...The sun is out. It's beautiful. Sand Beast, let's go home.
